column1: # compiler-generated DATA pins - the DATA analog of the RVA_COMPGEN source pin.
# A row names a datum cl.exe emits from a definition we already have in source, but
# which NEITHER of the two source-side data devices can reach:
#   * DATA(rva) rides an AST VarDecl in the MAIN file, so it is ignored inside a
#     header (labels.collect_vars is main-file-only) - and a function-local static
#     inside a header inline function lives exactly there;
#   * DATA_COMPGEN(rva, value) wraps a compiler-generated allocation AT ITS
#     USE SITE, so it needs a value expression - and a dynamic-init guard byte has
#     no source spelling at all (cl names it with a `??_B...@<counter>` ordinal it
#     assigns itself).
# WHY A MANIFEST AND NOT A MACRO. RVA_COMPGEN is a SOURCE pin because a
# compiler-generated FUNCTION belongs to one COMDAT in one TU's contribution, and
# its source position encodes that ownership (compgen_order ratchets it). These
# data have NO owning TU: cl emits each one as a COFF COMMON (a tentative
# definition) into EVERY TU that instantiates the inline, and the linker merges
# them into one bss slot. Any source position would fabricate an owner, so the pin
# has to be TU-independent.
# THIS IS NOT A RETURN OF THE RETIRED DATA_SYMBOL. DATA_SYMBOL was a SOURCE
# DECLARATION that let a datum exist as a name-only pin INSTEAD of a real C++
# definition. Every datum below has a real definition in the tree (see `emitter`);
# the only fact stated here is the retail ADDRESS, which the compiler cannot know.
# A row is refused unless cl actually emitted that symbol, at that size, as a
# COMMON in at least one base obj - so this can never conjure a datum that has no
# definition. Gated by `python -m gruntz.audit.compgen_data`, which also ratchets
# COMPLETENESS: every COMMON symbol in any base obj must be pinned here.
# Contrast with the `-functions` sibling in this directory: that file is
# evidence-only (never consumed) because `_$E<n>` ordinals are volatile. These
# names are stable - they are derived from the enclosing function's own mangling.
# Canonical spelling (gated): 4 tab-separated columns, rva zero-padded to 8 hex
# digits, size unpadded lowercase hex, rows sorted ascending by rva.
# rva
